ships.name: Agrunnos
ships.description: Mysterious gargantuan ship capable of digging up entire subcontinent of a Earth-sized planet and maintain atmosphere within. Due to sheer scale it is potentially one of the most heavily armed and defended ship known with countless of turrets and ships parked within. Arrival of a hostile Agrunnos with full complement could spell end for entire civilization. Note: Due to extreme size and unknown space anomaly caused by the ship, it requires 200 times the Hyperdrive or Jump Drive of normal ship to function.

ships.name: Aplomado
ships.description: Started from some veteran pirates modifying their Falcon to suit their need of long range durable cargo ship which eventually results in the Aplomado. Very little of the Falcon it was based on is left as the ship was upgraded and redesigned over the years, with other pirate captain showing interest and present enough money the Aplomado eventually becomes mass produced.

ships.name: Eleonorae
ships.description: Originally heavily modified Tarazed Falcon by commissioned by some member of the Crossguard Patrol group to be used as long-range fast cruiser with built-in advanced sensors to fight pirates and catch smugglers. Now it's a complete redesign with some outline resemblance to the Tarazed Falcon. Unlike the expertly modified Marauder ships or Aplomado hastily built by pirates, the Eleonorae was optimized and constructed with some of the best tech in Human space, it was rumoured that some component is actually derived from confidential military-grade technology. This made it potentially the of the most advanced warship civilian could get their hand on.

ships.name: Battle Bulk
ships.description: Results of pirates wondering what to do with captured Bulk Freighters as they were too slow and cumbersome for smuggling. The Battle Bulk were often used to battle against rival gang or the navy.

ships.name: Battle Behemoth
ships.description: To improve upon the Behemoth's already decent combat capability the pirates made extensive modifications to it and turn it into proper warship with large cargo hold perfect for plundering.

ships.name: Culverin Class
ships.description: A large arsenal ship recently developed and deployed by the navy. The Culverin Class arsenal ship carries over dozens of missile launchers and over half a thousand missiles to saturate the entire battlefield with enough missiles to easily overwhelm even the best anti-missile system available.

ships.name: Spetum Class
ships.description: Republic Navy Spetum Class Fleetcarrier is a massive carrier that doubles as mobile headquarter projecting power not only within the system but also to nearby systems. Spetum Class is the first spaceship to carry a complement of fighters on par with wet navy carriers of 20th century. With over 5 times more capacity than older carrier fleets appearance of a single Spetum Class can turn the tide of a battle. Public reaction was mixed, while the ship itself it a feat of engineering and a mark of progress in a way some thought the budget could've been better spent else where. Though the ship will be a major deterrence against pirates some were also concerned about the lives of fighter pilots who where often just cannon fodder. Nevertheless armchair generals were all at least somewhat satisfied with what they would consider an actual carrier.

ships.name: Dulle Griet Class
ships.description: Dulle Griet class fast battleship was developed as a solution to very limited production capacity of Canaveral Naval Yard thus another design was drafted up. The fast battleship was designed to be smaller and easier to build allowing more shipyard to build them in times of need. Unlike the Claymore which was designed to take on entire fleet by itself Dulle Griet could serve both as flagship for small patrol and escort for larger carriers like Spetum or Lucerne. Dulle Griet class primary armament is the advanced Eteron torpedoes to shatter any opposing warship before whittling the last of them down with 4 dual V85 railgun turrets and array of flakcannons.

ships.name: Grose Bochse Class
ships.description: Stemming from the same development line the Grose Bochse is designed to fit the ExP302 Railcannon, a slightly smaller version of the Railcannon used by Lucerne class and Claymore class now build into a smaller, cheaper, and easier to build frame. With tremendous firepower and range these ships were intended to form the backline of a battle bombarding enemy ships from far beyond their reach.

The ship itself is by far the largest interstellar vessel ever built by humanity truly going into the territory of mobile space station rather as their scale could be measured in kilometers.

ships.name: Nasprite
ships.description: Nasprite is a modernization of a dated armoured freighter design from the first turf war made to withstand combat and long travel. Though originates from the core, most of these are now found operating around the Dirt Belt.

ships.name: FR-4 Dart
ships.description: This was made with the goal of creating the smallest and cheapest spaceship possible. With everything reduced to the minimum, the FR-4 Dart was designed as an even cheaper alternative to the Betelgeuse Shuttle. Despite its' fragility, this ship is fast enough to outrun nearly everything else in human space.

ships.name: Wisymton
ships.description: A tugboat from early days of space trading made to transport cargo containers between ground and space. Designed when repulsor engines were still in their infancy, many ships from the previous era still lack one or were not designed to enter the atmosphere at all. ships.name: LGC-3 Mesa
ships.description: A purpose-built gas tanker used for shipping large amount of gas in liquefied or compressed form across the galaxy. Relatively rare due to their specialized nature mostly running along a few industrial worlds. Lightly armed but also less likely to attract pirate attention due to difficulty of storing and maintaining liquefied or compressed gas, making it one of the least economical targets for them. While pretty much useless in most situations, a gas tanker allows you to take special, very well paid jobs on some industrial planets. 	Due to nature of liquefied gas requiring extremely low temperature to maintain, any overheating can damage the tanks over time and eventually can cause it to burst. For that reason gas tanker captains must keep a close eye on their temperature at all time and make sure the temperature is always below the limit.

Due to their specialized nature these ships are also rarer and most often found in route between industrial planets or close by. With the difficulty of efficiently maintaining transported chemicals combined with requiring special ports to unload the stored liquid, these vessels are less preferred target for pirates. ships.name: SMC-2 Kipuka
ships.description: Kipuka is a specialized type of chemical tanker dedicated to carrying molasses. To ensure easy flow of molasses when filling and discharging, each tank is equipped with a special temperature management system that can evenly heat the liquid across the tank to maintain low enough viscosity during unloading process. The ship also employs a slightly different loading system to minimize foaming as well as specialized sensor to avoid inaccuracies from said foaming of the cargo. Because of the additional requirement for tank cleaning, these molasses tankers also come equipped with a special type of automatic tank cleaner to satisfy the requirement and reduce running cost.

ships.name: FG-7 Conveyor
ships.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. However, the CEO of the company simply told them to come get an actual carrier. It is rumoured that the company was responsible for the development of the more recent Spetum class carrier.

ships.name: HMM-190 Kotroger
ships.description: The Kotroger is a terrestrial mining vehicle with spaceflight capability for rapidly hopping from planets to planets or even within the planet itself as each resource pool is drained, as well as moving to assist excavation on other sites or large construction projects requiring earth to be moved in large amounts. While not as economical as old-school ground-based excavators, its primary strength lies in the extreme mobility compared to a regular excavator. It can easily move itself from site to site and begin operation within the same day, while regular ones may take days or weeks to disassemble, pack, and move, then repeat in reverse at the new site. Though it may be unnecessary on larger resource pools it allows the Kotroger to more economically extract resource from smaller pools of rarer materials that may otherwise be uneconomical for regular excavators to operate on. Though it is not recommended by both the manufacturer and safety organizations, the ship is built with extra heavy-duty long-duration repulsor engines that can fire constantly for longer periods which may allow it to temporarily mine resources from less stable terrain with repulsor engines active to minimize the pressure it puts on the ground.

ships.name: CK80T Tlielart
ships.description: A massive freighter designed to carry as much cargo as possible, and did so exceedingly that it surpass the capacity of every other ships by far. Though unlike the other ships from MarStel Industries, it is very lightly armed relative to cargo capacity, making it lack the firepower to properly protect itself and neither does it have the speed to dodge any raider. Due to such reasons, it will require decent escort to safely travel. 	Though it carries more than most, if not all, freighters in human space, the sheer amount of cargo that has to be unloaded requires ungodly amount of time, equipment, and manpower, which only gets worse when loading cargo. Any less than a well developed urban spaceport will struggle to service the ship and often will take a few days to complete the operation, if they ever require this much cargo in the first place. This results in the ship being not quite a popular choice in most of human space, as few planets require this much cargo in a single delivery and fewer capable of handling it.

ships.name: SKVS-4 Minnow
ships.description: A water tanker ship for transporting fresh water to nearby colonies or stations which are incapable of generating enough fresh water for themselves. The Minnow itself is slow and lightly armed making it incapable of defending itself or escaping from any threat, which makes it less ideal for travelling to frontier worlds alone with the rise of piracy. 	Now that most colonies are developed enough to supply their own water, these ships have become much rarer as the need for them decreases. Only a small number remain parked in systems that have stations for occasional resupply mission.

ships.name: TQK-20 Qaytas
ships.description: A specialized bulk-in bag-out ship designed in cooperation between Vefrol Dockyards and Pioneer Heavy Industries for the Core Food Corporation. This is to allow transportation of bulk sugar and in-ship bagging at destination to decrease port time during unloading, resulting in overall faster turnaround. The ship lacks large cargo loading hatches to maintain a closed system free of contaminants and instead loads via special sealed conveyor belts built into the ship. Its' built-in bagging facilities utilize the latest technology for fast and highly efficient packaging operation. Bagged sugar can be unloaded at the port far faster than in bulk as well as having the benefit of being less reliant on specialized sugar unloading equipment and storage that most ports do not have.

ships.name: QYG-30 Qazan
ships.description: A fast and well armoured freighter for medium-range shipping. Preferred by some captains for greater manoeuvrability compared to Syndicate Freighter.

ships.name: LMS-43 Mullsammler
ships.description: This ship was designed to collect garbage from various colonies in the days before they built their own garbage processing plants. With their compactors these ships can collect several times more cargo than a regular freighter. Even after a processing plant was built on a planet these vessels are still used to collect garbage from various settlements scattered around the planet. The ship is equipped with six compactors to quickly load the garbage, though practically the crew said three is more than enough for most small settlements this ship would be visiting and all compactors will only be utilized in more urban areas.

ships.name: FPd45 Clinker
ships.description: A hatchless self-unloading cargo ship specialized for carrying and handling powdered cargoes like cement. Because of the specially designed cargo holds and loading and unloading systems for granulated cargo, it cannot be used to transport any other kind of cargo. 	The Clinker was built in response to the growing demand for cement as small colonies grew into cities, though this model requires port-side facilities to properly unload directly to vehicles and will often only travel between ports with proper equipment.

ships.name: SRC-41C Curie
ships.description: The Curie-class is a purpose-built nuclear fuel carrier dedicated to transporting all sorts of radioactive cargo, like fresh nuclear fuel, spent nuclear fuel, and radioactive waste, with multiple redundancies for all critical systems, from engines, cooling system, electrical systems to navigation systems as well as reinforced bulkheads to resist even the most extreme accident while keeping their cargo intact. Though the bridge is visible, it is reinforced with additional armour and is mainly only used for landing and on-ground operations like unloading the cargo, with the ship's primary control room buried deep inside the ship, with another layer of armour around it, not unlike what one would have expected from a warship. With the requirement to keep the cargo cool all the time the ship also has a built-in dedicated cooling system for the cargo hold, which is isolated from the cooling systems for the rest of the ship as well as having its own backup generator. Though all radioactive cargo comes with its own radiation shielding container, the material for this ship's cargo hold is also selected to provide decent amount of shielding as well. 	Another part of the ship's safety includes crews specially trained to handle radioactive cargo as well as responding to various foreseeable incidents, from collision, fire, and pirates boarding, in the most unlikely case that it occurs. In addition to that, the ship is also equipped for in-flight repairs, allowing the ship to perform rudimentary repairs on itself if damaged, though there is a small delay before the repair can begin and longer delay if the ship got disabled. Because all of these facts the ship's minimum crew is almost the same as chemical tankers of larger size and operating cost is one of the highest.

ships.name: DSSN-S90 Lynchyoseu
ships.description: This is the DSSE Shipbuilding specialized fishing and fish processing vessel built to operate in both sea and space. It utilizes a uniquely engineered multi-mode engine that can operate efficiently both in sea, air, and vacuum. 	Unlike regular trawlers, this vessel can use its repulsor engines to lift itself just above the water, significantly increasing speed for the vessel, which allows it to catch fish faster as well as being able to catch some faster exotic fishes with a method called by some sailors "skimming". Due to these maneuvers the net is also designed to resist such speed and force as well as allowing it to hold many more fish than standard trawler nets. The captured fish can be quickly pulled inside the ship to be processed into fillet, block, canned or other forms as required before being sent to the frozen cargo holds to keep it from spoiling. Its ability to travel at higher speed in air also means the ship can travel between fishing spots far faster than standard water-bound fishing vessels, though this is done less often, as the extra strain means more maintenance later on, which can be uneconomical if done too often. Another unique option for these vessels is that it can be very opportunistic in stormy worlds where they can quickly snatch up rare marine animals unique to that world during a small window of calm sea and bail out at the last minute before the heavy storms and high waves hit them. 	Its space capability is also often utilized by owners of these vessels to rapidly move them around between worlds, as market demand shifts and new species of edible fish are discovered or between known types due to random influences. In addition to solo operations, these ships also have option of serving as mothership and carring two additional ships to assist the operation on longer expeditions for a more continuous supply of fish, while processed products are offloaded to another reefer ship whence the product is delivered to the port. 	Because of its adaptability and high efficiency, these vessels are almost universally hated by local fishermen, especially among worlds whose main export is marine products, to the point some worlds are considering the possibility of banning or greatly restricting the usage of these ships.

ships.name: TMS-64 Kernstoff
ships.description: A purpose-built tritium carrier with special equipment to maintain stability of the tritium over some distance, as well as multiple layers of protection to keep its cargo safe. Often used to deliver supplies to reactors or carry waste products from such reactors. Similarly to other vessels dedicated to carrying highly radioactive cargo, it is built to the highest standard with multiple redundancies and reinforcement for every critical systems allowing the ship to survive and function while sustaining damage that would've disabled other ships of similar size. 	Unlike the Curie-class built by the Syndicate, which heavily relies on escort to ward off pirates this ship is relatively heavily armed to allow it to defend itself to a degree, but in most case still travels with escorts to ensure security.

ships.name: Typ115 Qiongsha
ships.description: The CCS Corp. entry for budget freighter market. A small step up from the Syndicate Star Barge, the Qiongsha offers almost double the cargo capacity as well as all the benefits of containerized cargo. The Qiongsha is an ideal ship for a captain looking for something with more capacity than a Star Barge but without the money to buy a Freighter. 	With the low cost and high capacity the price is paid elsewhere. The container carrier is designed to the barest minimum required to fly and meet safety standards. It's said to be even more difficult to fly and land than the Syndicate Freighter by some captains, due to location of the cockpit and cheap sensors. Minimal durability and defense while carrying more cargo also make it an even more attractive target for pirates, so much so that many insurance companies refuse to cover it outside specific safe zones.

ships.name: F-HF51 Kinesaki
ships.description: Kinesaki is one of MJK Heavy Industries ancient freighter design developed shortly before the first turf war. For the time it was viewed as freighter of the future with rather comfortable living quarter compared to other freighter of the time. It's also known to be fairly capable in combat and contributes to significant amount of firepower in combat. There's even stories of some that served as powerful Q-Ship, one so lethal that few survived to tell the tale. Over time, Kinesaki-class were slowly phased out for newer, more efficient, and better protected cargo ships. Last of its' class was decommissioned from NGK fleet a few decades before the formation of the Republic. 	Although outdated and largely outperformed by more modern ships, it is still good enough for few merchants and small companies to keep it in service. While unlikely due to sheer amount of it built over time, it's probable that some of these ships in service may well be over half-millenia old. 	With the production of Kinesaki-class officially ceased centuries ago, most that are on sale right now are ancient stocks from since. With the condition varying from heavily repaired to basically brand new, suspiciously new even.

ships.name: C1-B Grainger
ships.description: An ancient cargo ship in service before the Alpha War. Its' builder was one of the corporation that was merged into the Syndicate and since long forgotten. It was one of the backbone of interstellar ore trade as older freighters that lack repulsor engines are fading out. Many of this model were lost in the following instability and war and fades out of relevance due to its' fragility and lack sufficient weaponry to protect itself. 	Due to sheer number built, a few of these relics survived until today, mostly in collector's warehouses or permanently grounded as housing for some early colonies. Though it's completely out-performed by modern freighters in every measure, a few can still be seen flying for various reason.

ships.name: KS-46 Nikolayev
ships.description: A heavily armed freighter emerging from period of instability shortly before the Alpha War. Equipped with array of weapons and defenses as well as heavy armour to ensure the safety of their cargo from pirates and privateer. Nikolayev-class providing warship level of firepower with capacity of freighter allows corporation's fleet to travel with less escort freeing up warships for other tasks. Due to it's design, armour and defence it's also occasionally used as troop transport and landing. 	While largely outdated, several of these can still be found in use for simple reason that it still works.

For that it fits into the gap between larger human freighters like Bluewhale and Conveyor.

ships.description: Originally heavily modified Tarazed Falcon by commissioned by some member of the Crossguard Patrol group to be used as long-range fast cruiser with built-in advanced sensors to fight pirates and catch smugglers. Now it's a complete redesign with some outline resemblance to the Tarazed Falcon. Unlike the expertly modified Marauder ships or Aplomado hastily built by pirates, the Eleonorae was optimized and constructed with some of the best tech in Human space, it was rumoured that some component is actually derived from confidential military-grade technology. This made it potentially the of the most advanced warship civilian could get their hand on.

ships.name: MGF: Spetum Class
ships.description: Republic Navy Spetum Class Fleetcarrier is a massive carrier that doubles as mobile headquarter projecting power not only within the system but also to nearby systems. Spetum Class is the first spaceship to carry a complement of fighters on par with wet navy carriers of 20th century. With over 5 times more capacity than older carrier fleets appearance of a single Spetum Class can turn the tide of a battle. Public reaction was mixed, while the ship itself it a feat of engineering and a mark of progress in a way some thought the budget could've been better spent else where. Though the ship will be a major deterrence against pirates some were also concerned about the lives of fighter pilots who where often just cannon fodder. Nevertheless armchair generals were all at least somewhat satisfied with what they would consider an actual carrier.

ships.name: MGF: Ranseur Class
ships.description: The Ranseur Class is considered a sub-class of Spetum with several major improvements across the broad.

ships.name: MGF: Dulle Griet Class
ships.description: Dulle Griet class fast battleship was developed as a solution to very limited production capacity of Canaveral Naval Yard thus another design was drafted up. The fast battleship was designed to be smaller and easier to build allowing more shipyard to build them in times of need. Unlike the Claymore which was designed to take on entire fleet by itself Dulle Griet could serve both as flagship for small patrol and escort for larger carriers like Spetum or Lucerne. Dulle Griet class primary armament is the advanced Eteron torpedoes to shatter any opposing warship before whittling the last of them down with 4 dual V85 railgun turrets and array of flakcannons.

ships.name: MGF: Grose Bochse Class
ships.description: Stemming from the same development line the Grose Bochse is designed to fit the ExP302 Railcannon, a slightly smaller version of the Railcannon used by Lucerne class and Claymore class now build into a smaller, cheaper, and easier to build frame. With tremendous firepower and range these ships were intended to form the backline of a battle bombarding enemy ships from far beyond their reach.

ships.name: MGF: Claymore Class
ships.description: Developed shortly after the alien attack at Farpoint as dedicated weapon platform very heavily armed with multiple large anti-capital turrets enough to shred most warships in seconds, it is essentially a mobile battlestation to fend off against future alien attack.

ships.name: MGF: Lucerne Class
ships.description: Republic Navy Supercarrier-Battleship hybrid heavily armed with multiple railgun turrets capable of tearing down smaller ships in seconds. While officially claimed to be recently developed to face against future alien invasion threat it was rumoured to be in research and development long before the war with Free Worlds for potential aggression from the Quarg or someone as advanced as them. The ship itself is by far the largest interstellar vessel ever built by humanity truly going into the territory of mobile space station rather as their scale could be measured in kilometers.

ships.name: CK80Tp Death Harmonica
ships.description: Heavily modified CK80T Tlielart freighter with 6 massive guns inplace of the cargo pods. The internal structure of the ship have also been reinforced (if not entirely overhauled in some area) to support the firing of its massive guns.

ships.name: F-VC56 Kaga
ships.description: Initially a plan pitched to the Republic Navy as they seek a new fleet carrier with enough capacity for 80 fighters now brought back into development as they realized the looming threat of aliens from all sides and funding to spare. Though the original plan was already considerably expensive, the additional development and modernization for new goal rise the cost through the roof. Unlike its predecessors Zuiho and Zuikaku the Kaga was not designed for mercantile escort (and for advertisement) and deterrence with most threat being large pirate fleet where it still have to be somewhat economically viable to build and operate. Kaga Class is designed for greatest chance of victory in combat against potentially more advanced alien with capacity for 90 fighters spread across 3 flight decks for rapid deployment and recovery along with a large array of cutting-edge armaments to out gun any alien warship it may find.

ships.name: H-BS140 Yamato
ships.description: The Yamato is a heavy battleship designed to utilize few large and heavy turret as primary armament drawing inspiration from an ancient naval battleship of the same name. It also uses large array of VLS missiles as additional firepower. To compensate for lack of turn rate of the large turret it employs a large array of smaller turrets to protect itself against smaller and faster vessels and missiles. Large spinal cannon is also equipped on bow of the ship that can deal a massive amount of damage to any enemy vessel. The ship is also notably a lot larger than its namesake to fit all the required technologies employing latest iteration of highly efficient and durable shield emitter as well as large array of defensive anti-missile and anti-fighter turrets.

ships.name: E-FD23 Kanran
ships.description: Kanran is a very old destroyer designed by MJK heavy industries for their security department to protect their properties as well as raiding enemy convoys during the first turf war and sequentially also participated in the Alpha War. At its time it was considered one of the most advanced ship in the sky second only to those from the Deep and with sheer number it was manufactured many survived the conflict and were continually improved that some still survives to this day. Production of this model fluctuates over time but generally on descending trend before stopping not long after the formation of the Republic. Now most of Kanran on the market are ones decomissioned from NGK fleets.

Spetum Class is the first spaceship to carry a complement of fighters on par with wet navy carriers of 20th century. With over 5 times more capacity than older carrier fleets appearance of a single Spetum Class can turn the tide of a battle. Public reaction was mixed, while the ship itself it a feat of engineering and a mark of progress in a way some thought the budget could've been better spent else where. Though the ship will be a major deterrence against pirates some were also concerned about the lives of fighter pilots who where often just cannon fodder. Nevertheless armchair generals were all at least somewhat satisfied with what they would consider an actual carrier.

variants.name: FG-7 Conveyor-A
variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. However, the CEO of the company simply told them to come get an actual carrier. It is rumoured that the company was responsible for the development of the more recent Spetum class carrier.

variants.name: FG-7 Conveyor (GX)
variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. However, the CEO of the company simply told them to come get an actual carrier. It is rumoured that the company was responsible for the development of the more recent Spetum class carrier.

variants.name: KS-58 Vinograd (Modernized)
variants.description: Following the success of the Nikolayev-class, KDB designed another bigger armed freighter. Although only a few were completed before the Alpha War before production came to a halt because of it. The production resumed some period after the war but never to the scale it was originally intended to be. The construction of these vessel is largely stopped towards the formation of the Republic. 	Although very outdated, these vessels is somehow not entirely gone from active merchant fleets. A small number of them can also be found in service of some Dirt Belt and Southern planet mostly as part of reserve fleet.

variants.name: CSE-6 Steward (GX)
variants.description: Steward is an escort carrier with decent firepower. While it can handle most threat up to a medium warship by itself. Its small complement of fighters can assist defending far end of convoys from small attacks, but anything more than a few interceptors will be troubling.

variants.name: Sparrow (Ugyr)
variants.description: Classified as an interceptor rather than a fighter because it has its own hyperdrive instead of needing to be carried inside a larger ship, the Tarazed Sparrow is the smallest and cheapest combat ship available. Because of its limited cargo and passenger space, the primary way for a Sparrow pilot to pay the bills is to upgrade the weapons and hunt pirates... or become one. In either case, it is a perilous way to earn a living. 	Government reports indicate that as many as two out of every three first-time ship buyers who choose to pilot a Sparrow lose their ship (and often, their life as well) within the first month of owning it. Pilots who have survived longer than that tend to swear by replacing the stock weapons with missile launchers.

variants.name: MGF: Dulle Griet Class (Dulle Griet Class (Early))
variants.description: Dulle Griet class fast battleship was developed as a solution to very limited production capacity of Canaveral Naval Yard thus another design was drafted up. The fast battleship was designed to be smaller and easier to build allowing more shipyard to build them in times of need. Unlike the Claymore which was designed to take on entire fleet by itself Dulle Griet could serve both as flagship for small patrol and escort for larger carriers like Spetum or Lucerne. Dulle Griet class primary armament is the advanced Eteron torpedoes to shatter any opposing warship before whittling the last of them down with 4 dual V85 railgun turrets and array of flakcannons.

variants.name: MGF: Lucerne Class (Lucerne Class MkII)
variants.description: Republic Navy Supercarrier-Battleship hybrid heavily armed with multiple railgun turrets capable of tearing down smaller ships in seconds. While officially claimed to be recently developed to face against future alien invasion threat it was rumoured to be in research and development long before the war with Free Worlds for potential aggression from the Quarg or someone as advanced as them. The ship itself is by far the largest interstellar vessel ever built by humanity truly going into the territory of mobile space station rather as their scale could be measured in kilometers.

variants.name: Frigate (Mark II, Pocket)
variants.description: For centuries, the Frigate was the largest warship produced by the Republic Navy Yard, but now they seem quite small compared to a Cruiser or a Carrier. Armed with a variety of weapons, the Frigate is equally capable at fending off small fighters or bombarding larger ships. In its time it possessed relatively good maneuverability for a ship of its size, but now it sees continued use mostly due to the sheer number of them already built for service.

variants.name: Enforcer (Ankulah)
variants.description: Prior to the formation of the galactic Republic, many star systems were owned by "governing corporate entities," with the vast majority of space being inaccessible to private citizens. The only exception to this rule were the pirate bands, whose few ships were often stolen or rebellious corporate fleets of their own, yet who had an outsized impact on interstellar trade. The necessity for corporations to protect their operations meant that Enforcer was one of the most common vessels used for security and defense. The ship boasts an armament of four gun ports and a turreted mount, all packed on a small but defensible frame that was powerful for its time. 	Although no longer on the market, the Enforcer finds itself in the possession of a small number of merchants and, ironically, various groups of pirates, as an aging combat ship easily outperformed by other light warships or even interceptors of a similar size.

variants.name: Quicksilver (Rangphenn Escort)
variants.description: The Megaparsec Quicksilver is a warship built around a single concept: to design the smallest and fastest ship capable of carrying two Particle Cannons. Because of its speed, reverse thrusters, and long weapons range, the Quicksilver can keep a safe distance from most targets and bombard them with particle bursts until they are destroyed. The focus on its weaponry left the Quicksilver with no room for even the most basic shield generator. Unfortunately the Headhunter eventually surpassed the original design intent, but the Quicksilver's better durability to cost ratio, and the existence of long-term contracts, has kept it in use with Syndicate security forces.

variants.name: FG-7 Conveyor (NBSL)
variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. However, the CEO of the company simply told them to come get an actual carrier. It is rumoured that the company was responsible for the development of the more recent Spetum class carrier.

variants.name: CDB-6K Jupiter (NBSL)
variants.description: A dry bulk carrier geared with derricks for unloading cargo in less-equipped ports, in the earlier days of bulk interstellar trade. Unlike container ships, these bulk carriers can be loaded with unpacked dry cargoes like ores and grain directly in their cargo bays, lessening the need for the cargo to be packaged from the destination.

Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

variants.name: Quicksilver (EPB3-2)
variants.description: The Megaparsec Quicksilver is a warship built around a single concept: to design the smallest and fastest ship capable of carrying two Particle Cannons. Because of its speed, reverse thrusters, and long weapons range, the Quicksilver can keep a safe distance from most targets and bombard them with particle bursts until they are destroyed. The focus on its weaponry left the Quicksilver with no room for even the most basic shield generator. Unfortunately the Headhunter eventually surpassed the original design intent, but the Quicksilver's better durability to cost ratio, and the existence of long-term contracts, has kept it in use with Syndicate security forces.

variants.name: MGF: Spetum Class (Spetum Class (Mark II))
variants.description: Republic Navy Spetum Class Fleetcarrier is a massive carrier that doubles as mobile headquarter projecting power not only within the system but also to nearby systems. Spetum Class is the first spaceship to carry a complement of fighters on par with wet navy carriers of 20th century. With over 5 times more capacity than older carrier fleets appearance of a single Spetum Class can turn the tide of a battle. Public reaction was mixed, while the ship itself it a feat of engineering and a mark of progress in a way some thought the budget could've been better spent else where. Though the ship will be a major deterrence against pirates some were also concerned about the lives of fighter pilots who where often just cannon fodder. Nevertheless armchair generals were all at least somewhat satisfied with what they would consider an actual carrier.

Spetum Class is the first spaceship to carry a complement of fighters on par with wet navy carriers of 20th century. With over 5 times more capacity than older carrier fleets appearance of a single Spetum Class can turn the tide of a battle. Public reaction was mixed, while the ship itself it a feat of engineering and a mark of progress in a way some thought the budget could've been better spent else where. Though the ship will be a major deterrence against pirates some were also concerned about the lives of fighter pilots who where often just cannon fodder. Nevertheless armchair generals were all at least somewhat satisfied with what they would consider an actual carrier.

variants.description: The Megaparsec Quicksilver is a warship built around a single concept: to design the smallest and fastest ship capable of carrying two Particle Cannons. Because of its speed, reverse thrusters, and long weapons range, the Quicksilver can keep a safe distance from most targets and bombard them with particle bursts until they are destroyed. The focus on its weaponry left the Quicksilver with no room for even the most basic shield generator. Unfortunately the Headhunter eventually surpassed the original design intent, but the Quicksilver's better durability to cost ratio, and the existence of long-term contracts, has kept it in use with Syndicate security forces.

variants.name: Sparrow (Black Death)
variants.description: Classified as an interceptor rather than a fighter because it has its own hyperdrive instead of needing to be carried inside a larger ship, the Tarazed Sparrow is the smallest and cheapest combat ship available. Because of its limited cargo and passenger space, the primary way for a Sparrow pilot to pay the bills is to upgrade the weapons and hunt pirates... or become one. In either case, it is a perilous way to earn a living. 	Government reports indicate that as many as two out of every three first-time ship buyers who choose to pilot a Sparrow lose their ship (and often, their life as well) within the first month of owning it. Pilots who have survived longer than that tend to swear by replacing the stock weapons with missile launchers.

variants.description: The Tarazed Hawk is an interceptor-class warship often used as an escort for freighters or in a planetary militia's patrol squadron. Hawks are fast enough to chase down most smaller ships, but are capable of mounting much more powerful weapons. They are also, of course, a favorite ship of pirate captains who have earned enough money to afford one.

variants.name: Dagger (Black Death)
variants.description: The Dagger is a fighter designed by Lionheart Industries, intended to be carried by their Aerie warship, although other ships have been known to carry them, as well. As with many Lionheart ships, its chassis is largely composed of lightweight composite materials, making it considerably faster than other fighters. 	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

variants.name: EP-1 Mole (Javelin)
variants.description: An automated mining drone developed and used by Espion Mining Co. Due to their specialized nature these drones come with built-in asteroid scanners.

variants.name: EP-1 Mole (Torpedo)
variants.description: An automated mining drone developed and used by Espion Mining Co. Due to their specialized nature these drones come with built-in asteroid scanners.

variants.name: EM-28F Wombat (Combat)
variants.description: Espion-exclusive mining carrier, or rather a mobile mining and refinery station to extract and process resources on the go as due to its large cargo holds it may spend much of its time in flight to collect a full cargo of resources. Because of its size and slowness, the vessel is less than ideal for mining and collecting resources itself, but instead relies on a sizable fleet of fighters and drones to mine and collect resources for it. To protect their miners from harm as they operate far away from the mothership, the Wombat also comes with space for 4 pocket light warships to guard the miners.

variants.name: EM-8A Armadillo (Armadillo (Weapon))
variants.description: Espion-exclusive light mining carrier with sizeable squadron of drones and fighters for defending itself, or help mining and collecting materials.

variants.name: Sunder (Espion)
variants.description: The Sunder is a versatile mining platform equipped with dedicated prospecting equipment, most notably an undercarriage that supports two Mining Drones. The lineage of this ship can be traced back to the old asteroid mining ships used in the Sol Main Belt centuries ago; however, because of recent Syndicate efforts to further exploit the Core's mineral wealth, the newest model of the Sunder is now manufactured by Syndicated Shipyards.

variants.name: Sparrow (Espion)
variants.description: Classified as an interceptor rather than a fighter because it has its own hyperdrive instead of needing to be carried inside a larger ship, the Tarazed Sparrow is the smallest and cheapest combat ship available. Because of its limited cargo and passenger space, the primary way for a Sparrow pilot to pay the bills is to upgrade the weapons and hunt pirates... or become one. In either case, it is a perilous way to earn a living. 	Government reports indicate that as many as two out of every three first-time ship buyers who choose to pilot a Sparrow lose their ship (and often, their life as well) within the first month of owning it. Pilots who have survived longer than that tend to swear by replacing the stock weapons with missile launchers.

variants.name: Shuttle (Kamikaze)
variants.description: Although Betelgeuse Shipyards produces other ship models as well, the majority of their profits come from sales of the Shuttle. This versatile ship serves equally well as a passenger transport or a cargo courier. It also happens to be the cheapest ship you can buy which is capable of hyperspace travel. 	Shuttles are not designed to withstand combat of any sort, but they are fast and maneuverable enough to get out of harm's way if attacked by a larger, slower ship. Although they are typically unarmed, they have enough space for one weapon, which is the origin of the popular phrase, "as useless as a blaster cannon on a shuttlecraft."

variants.description: A well defended livestock transport for shipping various live exports from the southern worlds to their destination safely. variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. variants.name: FG-10 Exchanger (Post-Lucerne, Upgrade I)
variants.description: Inspired by the Syndicate H-class super container ship, a smaller freighter development was halted in favor of an even larger freighter, perhaps the largest freighter to ever be developed in human space. The hull of the smaller predecessor in development was modified and used as the Exchanger primary cargo arms that can be deployed to land and unload cargo, as the Exchanger itself is too large to land on any port. 	To protect itself the ship carries a vast array of armaments rivalling most warships as well as entire wings of fighters to protect itself. Though the sub cargo ships attached to the arms can be deployed, they were stripped down too much to serve as effective combat ship on its' own. In addition there is also a longer delay to deploy, as they were not designed for immediate action.

variants.thumbnail: thumbnail/mgf syn hclass super container thumb
variants.description: This massive super container ship is the next step in the Syndicate's attempt to regain dominance over the heavy freighter market, with over double the capacity of the previous largest freighter. Similarly to its predecessor, the G-Class Container Transport, it carries a fleet of drones to assist in unloading, as well as allowing it to unload at smaller spaceports that may not be able to handle its size, by simply parking in orbit and transporting containers to surface with the ship's own drones and tugboats from the port instead. This allows the ship to visit most if not all ports without worrying about landing area or unloading gears delivering both large and small amount of cargo to various destination.

variants.name: CK80T Tlielart (Tlielart (Long Range))
variants.description: A massive freighter designed to carry as much cargo as possible, and did so exceedingly that it surpass the capacity of every other ships by far. Though unlike the other ships from MarStel Industries, it is very lightly armed relative to cargo capacity, making it lack the firepower to properly protect itself and neither does it have the speed to dodge any raider. Due to such reasons, it will require decent escort to safely travel. 	Though it carries more than most, if not all, freighters in human space, the sheer amount of cargo that has to be unloaded requires ungodly amount of time, equipment, and manpower, which only gets worse when loading cargo. Any less than a well developed urban spaceport will struggle to service the ship and often will take a few days to complete the operation, if they ever require this much cargo in the first place. This results in the ship being not quite a popular choice in most of human space, as few planets require this much cargo in a single delivery and fewer capable of handling it.

variants.name: Quicksilver (MGF: Zhizhe)
variants.description: The Megaparsec Quicksilver is a warship built around a single concept: to design the smallest and fastest ship capable of carrying two Particle Cannons. Because of its speed, reverse thrusters, and long weapons range, the Quicksilver can keep a safe distance from most targets and bombard them with particle bursts until they are destroyed. The focus on its weaponry left the Quicksilver with no room for even the most basic shield generator. Unfortunately the Headhunter eventually surpassed the original design intent, but the Quicksilver's better durability to cost ratio, and the existence of long-term contracts, has kept it in use with Syndicate security forces.

variants.name: LGC-3 Mesa (Mesa (LNG Filled))
variants.description: A purpose-built gas tanker used for shipping large amount of gas in liquefied or compressed form across the galaxy. Relatively rare due to their specialized nature mostly running along a few industrial worlds. Lightly armed but also less likely to attract pirate attention due to difficulty of storing and maintaining liquefied or compressed gas, making it one of the least economical targets for them. While pretty much useless in most situations, a gas tanker allows you to take special, very well paid jobs on some industrial planets. 	Due to nature of liquefied gas requiring extremely low temperature to maintain, any overheating can damage the tanks over time and eventually can cause it to burst. For that reason gas tanker captains must keep a close eye on their temperature at all time and make sure the temperature is always below the limit.

variants.description: This is a purpose-built chemical tanker for shipping various industrial chemicals, including highly corrosive acids, with efficiency unmatched by regular freighters. Due to their specialized nature these ships are also rarer and most often found in route between industrial planets or close by. With the difficulty of efficiently maintaining transported chemicals combined with requiring special ports to unload the stored liquid, these vessels are less preferred target for pirates. While not useful in general shipping between most worlds, these ships profit of their extreme specialization to take on fewer but much more profitable jobs which are only offered on industrialized worlds.

variants.name: TQK-20 Qaytas (White Sugar)
variants.description: A specialized bulk-in bag-out ship designed in cooperation between Vefrol Dockyards and Pioneer Heavy Industries for the Core Food Corporation. This is to allow transportation of bulk sugar and in-ship bagging at destination to decrease port time during unloading, resulting in overall faster turnaround. The ship lacks large cargo loading hatches to maintain a closed system free of contaminants and instead loads via special sealed conveyor belts built into the ship. Its' built-in bagging facilities utilize the latest technology for fast and highly efficient packaging operation. Bagged sugar can be unloaded at the port far faster than in bulk as well as having the benefit of being less reliant on specialized sugar unloading equipment and storage that most ports do not have.

variants.name: SRC-41C Curie (Downgraded)
variants.description: The Curie-class is a purpose-built nuclear fuel carrier dedicated to transporting all sorts of radioactive cargo, like fresh nuclear fuel, spent nuclear fuel, and radioactive waste, with multiple redundancies for all critical systems, from engines, cooling system, electrical systems to navigation systems as well as reinforced bulkheads to resist even the most extreme accident while keeping their cargo intact. Though the bridge is visible, it is reinforced with additional armour and is mainly only used for landing and on-ground operations like unloading the cargo, with the ship's primary control room buried deep inside the ship, with another layer of armour around it, not unlike what one would have expected from a warship. With the requirement to keep the cargo cool all the time the ship also has a built-in dedicated cooling system for the cargo hold, which is isolated from the cooling systems for the rest of the ship as well as having its own backup generator. Though all radioactive cargo comes with its own radiation shielding container, the material for this ship's cargo hold is also selected to provide decent amount of shielding as well. 	Another part of the ship's safety includes crews specially trained to handle radioactive cargo as well as responding to various foreseeable incidents, from collision, fire, and pirates boarding, in the most unlikely case that it occurs. In addition to that, the ship is also equipped for in-flight repairs, allowing the ship to perform rudimentary repairs on itself if damaged, though there is a small delay before the repair can begin and longer delay if the ship got disabled. Because all of these facts the ship's minimum crew is almost the same as chemical tankers of larger size and operating cost is one of the highest.

variants.name: Sparrow (Rakin)
variants.description: Classified as an interceptor rather than a fighter because it has its own hyperdrive instead of needing to be carried inside a larger ship, the Tarazed Sparrow is the smallest and cheapest combat ship available. Because of its limited cargo and passenger space, the primary way for a Sparrow pilot to pay the bills is to upgrade the weapons and hunt pirates... or become one. In either case, it is a perilous way to earn a living. 	Government reports indicate that as many as two out of every three first-time ship buyers who choose to pilot a Sparrow lose their ship (and often, their life as well) within the first month of owning it. Pilots who have survived longer than that tend to swear by replacing the stock weapons with missile launchers.

variants.name: Scrapper (Rakin)
variants.description: Rather than being a specific model of ship, the Scrappers are instead a family of vessels cobbled together from the remains of broken shuttles. On the rare occasion that Republic authorities bother to recognize their existence, Scrappers are treated as almost-illegal, patent-infringing death traps. Despite this, these ships are where many captains (and pirates) from poorer backgrounds get their start.

variants.name: Enforcer (Ankulah, Defensive)
variants.description: Prior to the formation of the galactic Republic, many star systems were owned by "governing corporate entities," with the vast majority of space being inaccessible to private citizens. The only exception to this rule were the pirate bands, whose few ships were often stolen or rebellious corporate fleets of their own, yet who had an outsized impact on interstellar trade. The necessity for corporations to protect their operations meant that Enforcer was one of the most common vessels used for security and defense. The ship boasts an armament of four gun ports and a turreted mount, all packed on a small but defensible frame that was powerful for its time. 	Although no longer on the market, the Enforcer finds itself in the possession of a small number of merchants and, ironically, various groups of pirates, as an aging combat ship easily outperformed by other light warships or even interceptors of a similar size.

variants.name: F-HF51 Kinesaki (F-HF51a Arasaki)
variants.description: Kinesaki is one of MJK Heavy Industries ancient freighter design developed shortly before the first turf war. For the time it was viewed as freighter of the future with rather comfortable living quarter compared to other freighter of the time. It's also known to be fairly capable in combat and contributes to significant amount of firepower in combat. There's even stories of some that served as powerful Q-Ship, one so lethal that few survived to tell the tale. Over time, Kinesaki-class were slowly phased out for newer, more efficient, and better protected cargo ships. Last of its' class was decommissioned from NGK fleet a few decades before the formation of the Republic. variants.name: F-VC56 Kaga (Early)
variants.description: Initially a plan pitched to the Republic Navy as they seek a new fleet carrier with enough capacity for 80 fighters now brought back into development as they realized the looming threat of aliens from all sides and funding to spare. Though the original plan was already considerably expensive, the additional development and modernization for new goal rise the cost through the roof. Unlike its predecessors Zuiho and Zuikaku the Kaga was not designed for mercantile escort (and for advertisement) and deterrence with most threat being large pirate fleet where it still have to be somewhat economically viable to build and operate. Kaga Class is designed for greatest chance of victory in combat against potentially more advanced alien with capacity for 90 fighters spread across 3 flight decks for rapid deployment and recovery along with a large array of cutting-edge armaments to out gun any alien warship it may find.

variants.name: H-BS140 Yamato (Early)
variants.description: The Yamato is a heavy battleship designed to utilize few large and heavy turret as primary armament drawing inspiration from an ancient naval battleship of the same name. It also uses large array of VLS missiles as additional firepower. To compensate for lack of turn rate of the large turret it employs a large array of smaller turrets to protect itself against smaller and faster vessels and missiles. Large spinal cannon is also equipped on bow of the ship that can deal a massive amount of damage to any enemy vessel. The ship is also notably a lot larger than its namesake to fit all the required technologies employing latest iteration of highly efficient and durable shield emitter as well as large array of defensive anti-missile and anti-fighter turrets.

variants.name: CDB-6K Jupiter (NGK, Partial Turret Upgrade)
variants.description: A dry bulk carrier geared with derricks for unloading cargo in less-equipped ports, in the earlier days of bulk interstellar trade. Unlike container ships, these bulk carriers can be loaded with unpacked dry cargoes like ores and grain directly in their cargo bays, lessening the need for the cargo to be packaged from the destination.

variants.name: FG-5 Bluewhale-A (NGK, Turret Upgrade)
variants.description: Bluewhale is a massive freighter for hauling large amount of cargo across the galaxy. Due to its' cost these ships are often owned by freight companies rather than individuals. While it's capable of carrying much more cargo than most other freighters, one of the major complaints received from captains is that it can take very long to reach the innermost container. That said it is still far faster and easier than handling of bulk cargo.

variants.name: FG-7 Conveyor-A (NGK, Turret Upgrade)
variants.description: The Conveyor is a massive freighter designed and built by Freight Galactic with a special mechanism for quickly unloading cargo, independent of port equipment. It also has extra ports for resupplying, theoretically allowing them to trade much faster than ships of similar size. In practice this is debatable as few ports can keep up with the sheer amount of cargo due to various other factors. 	The Conveyor is also capable of carrying a small squadron of fighters to protect itself, and due to number of fighters carried, almost matching entire capacity of the Navy Carrier there were attempts to have it restricted. However, the CEO of the company simply told them to come get an actual carrier. It is rumoured that the company was responsible for the development of the more recent Spetum class carrier.

variants.description: A specialized roll-on roll-off ship for efficiently transporting land vehicles in large number, by having the interior laid out akin to parking lot, allowing vehicles to be driven on and off the ship by itself fast and easily without having to wait for cranes. outfits.name: Thyrupp Industrial Systems
outfits.description: Complete industrial system for processing ores and manufacturing basic products built into the ship. Need one landing after purchase to activate the system. This system will refine certain amount of harvested material everyday as long as it's installed on the flag ship. Requires at least 10 tons of harvested material to process into 10 tons of refined materials. Refined materials can be further processed into products 2 tons at a time. Max 1 of the Thyrupp Industrial Systems can be stacked, beyond that will have no effect.

outfits.name: M-type 1k Gas Tank
outfits.description: Universal gas tank capable of storing either liquefied gas or compressed gas built into the LGC-3 Mesa class gas tanker ships allowing it to transport gases without relaying on special containers improving speed, capacity, and overall efficiency of the transportation. These tanks are built with high strength materials to withstand extremely high pressure and layered with advanced insulations along with dedicated cooling systems to keep the cargo at right temperature. Having ships with dedicated gas tanks allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting gas.

It is also installed with sensors in various point to monitor the cargo and make sure it's in perfect condition. Having ships with dedicated sugar bay as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting sugar.

outfits.name: U-type 500 Molasses Tank
outfits.description: Purpose-built molasses tank for fast and efficient transportation of molasses. It comes with heating coil to heat the cargo to ideal temperature for pumping out when unloading. The tank interior is also coated with special coating for easier cleaning. Having ships with dedicated molasses tank as flagship allow you to be offered special jobs for transporting molasses.

outfits.name: T3-S-T Heavy Shock Turret
outfits.description: Massive primary turret of the Yamato-class Heavy Battleship with the mass of an entire small ship. It requires a direct powerline from a special type of reactor developed by MJK Heavy Industries. Capable of crippling a medium-sized warship in a single blow. Because of its sheer size it requires a dedicated crew housed inside the turret as well as independent backup targeting system allowing it to still operate if the ship's main targeting system is down.

outfits.name: Q4L Pulse Anti-Missile
outfits.description: The Heavy Anti-Missile Turret has a longer range, higher power, and shorter reload time than its smaller sibling. The only way to overcome it is by firing missiles in a cluster so that while one is being targeted, the others can get through, and as a result all missile systems on the market now default to firing in clusters if multiple copies of the same launcher are installed, rather than staggering their fire as ordinary guns do.

outfits.description: An early stage in the development of better and faster weaponry to rival that of the Wanderers, the Tripulse Shredder consists of three Pulse Cannons in a single housing. Advancements in cooling capabilities have reduced the heat generated by each shot at the cost of drawing slightly more power. Additionally, the single shared housing results in a less consistent firing pattern, limiting it to bursts. These factors have made the Tripulse Shredder a popular hit-and-run weapon among the Unfettered.

This model improves shield generation efficiency as well as notably improve shield's ability to resist damage. Due to difficulty and highly specific requirements this is rarely done. It was rumored the programming for this ship was the first field testing of the concept and it took a combined power of multiple supercomputers and quantum computers several months to complete. Aside from fairly rugged look of the module most of the cost for it was the licensing.

description.text: The Syndicate has a generous vacation policy on Foundry that allows workers to take as much as a month of vacation time every year, and many choose to take that time to escape from the cities and explore the wilderness. The shipyards claim that this vacation time is partly responsible for the high reliability of the ships built here, because a well-rested and relaxed worker is less likely to make the sort of mistakes that can quickly become disastrous in outer space.

spaceport.text: Everything is made of gleaming metal, and each tower is slightly tapered and adorned with painted fins that make it resemble an enormous starship.

description.text: A few enterprising settlers have taken up farming of some native plants that are edible for humans, including one plant similar to cranberries that has come to be considered a rare delicacy by many.

spaceport.text: Inside, however, it is completely different: the ceilings are high, with sun-lamps that provide some sense of warmth and cheer, and native wood paneling or stucco on most of the walls to soften them.

description.text: Fish are common here, including a few species of flying fish which travel in large packs and are a considerable nuisance for the land-dwellers.

spaceport.text: The whole complex sways slightly, almost imperceptibly, as if it were a large boat at sea. The walkways all have tall railings, but you still find yourself afraid to venture too near the edge or to look down at the island and the sea below. The locals, however, walk swiftly and gracefully, with no sign of fear.

description.text: Some tourists also come here, to walk through the sandstone canyons where the wind and rain has carved the rock into tall pillars and spires. A few particularly beautiful canyons are protected against strip mining by local law.

spaceport.text: Inside, people move at a slower and calmer pace, something which appears friendlier to tourists than other parts of the Deep.

description.text: Some of the excavation vehicles used here are as large and costly as a capital starship and as noisy as a volcano. Vast scars of strip mines span across the landscape. On this planet the environment is something to be endured rather than cherished.

spaceport.text: You could feel the oppressive force of this planet's gravity as soon as you landed. The spaceport is a small cluster of single-story buildings. More cargo seems to be handled by robotic vehicles than by actual human operators, but the few people walking past you are all much shorter than you are. You feel like a giant, clearly out of place.

description.text: The farms grow both food crops and cotton, and very recently they have begun manufacturing their own textiles instead of just shipping the raw cotton off-world for processing.

spaceport.text: Despite the relative recency of settlement, Remembrance Day celebrations appear to be occurring, with Alpha Wars ballads audible from one of the spaceport buildings.

description.text: Sinter is a world where life never developed; the atmosphere is unbreathable, but warm enough and dense enough that people can survive here in pressurized homes or outside when wearing oxygen tanks. The only industry here is mining, which is mostly done with remotely controlled robots, so the population of the entire planet is only a few thousand people.

spaceport.text: The only sign that Remembrance Day is celebrated on this planet is a single monitor in the spaceport displaying the text, "Happy Remembrance Day!"

description.text: Stormhold is a cold planet, with a dense, foggy atmosphere. As with many pirate outposts, Stormhold is home to an unknown number of villages and hidden outposts, each controlled by a different pirate faction. It is also said that some of the most dangerous fugitives in the galaxy live deep in the forests of this planet, escaping detection by living underground or by avoiding the use of electronic devices.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is a large town, with a population of roughly thirty thousand. People of all races and cultures mingle freely, while keeping a wary eye open for off-worlders who may be Republic agents in disguise.

description.text: From above, the planet looks almost lifeless and barren. Most of the major cities on Ada are built into the walls of the canyons, where they are protected from the high winds and occasional dust storms that sweep across the surface.

spaceport.text: Behind the docking caves is a bustling subterranean city where bare rock and gleaming metal have been woven together in an architecture that is both functional and elegant. The lighting in the caverns varies over the course of the day to match the sunlight outside.

description.text: Conducting any business here is a nightmare of tedium. Syndicate doctrine claims that corporate structure and process produce a leaner and more effective military force without the perceived wastage of the Republic Navy. But in practice, they seem to have combined all the worst aspects of military and corporate bureaucracy.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is mostly a military base. Uniformed crew members hurry back and forth without giving you a second glance. The food in the mess hall is standard military fare, hearty but bland and unappetizing, and there are few shops or other services catering to civilians.

description.text: Local rumors tell about an alien species of "canyon people" who live in caves in some of the deepest canyons, leading to a constant stream of visiting xenobiologists. The scientific consensus, however, is that these sightings have only been of a reclusive ape-like species that lives in the canyons, and is not known to dig caves or show any other sign of civilization.

spaceport.text: You notice quite a few families with children sitting by the windows on the upper stories of the tower, watching starships landing and taking off. Many of them have brought folding chairs or blankets to sit on. That must be what passes for entertainment on this world.

description.text: The close quarters have fostered an extreme scrupulosity about personal space. It is unnerving to walk down a densely crowded hallway and fail to make eye contact with anyone.

spaceport.text: Every few minutes, light flashes in through one of the windows from welders outside in space suits trying to keep the aging hull in perfect shape. Others drift around outside checking up on the solar panels and replacing burnt-out modules.

description.text: Many of the inhabitants are in fact not pirates, but their descendants, and these children and grand-children of anarchist outlaws have built a system of regional government that oversees hospitals, schools, and other public services, all created without funding from the Republic or taxes paid to it. The planet even sports its own shipyard, although many of the ships built here are, not surprisingly, based on designs pirated from the Syndicate and Republic shipyards.

spaceport.text: This is the sort of spaceport you picture in your head when you think of pirates. Half the storefronts are bars, and rum seems to be on the menu everywhere. It is almost like the stories of ancient Earth, except that the eye patches are cybernetic implants and the peg legs are motorized prostheses. Swarthy, dangerous-looking women glance at you as you pass by, and scantily clad men crowd around the bars, which is what you seem to remember the stories said it was like on Earth, too, although there it may have been the other way around.

description.text: Watcher is a small moon, the only world in this system that sustains any indigenous life. Because of the low gravity, humans have not yet built a permanent settlement here, but it is occasionally visited by biologists interested in studying low-gravity life forms. There are forests here where the trees grow over two hundred meters tall.

Although Quicksilver has vast mineral resources, the tectonic activity makes underground mining far too dangerous. However, a few enterprising settlers work in surface mining and mountaintop removal. The results are ugly, but this is a far too inhospitable world for anyone to care what it looks like.

spaceport.text: Amenities here are minimal: a small cafeteria selling hot drinks and warm stew, and a marketplace mostly filled with stacks of refined steel and aluminum and titanium for sale. A smaller stack of lead-lined crates hold radioactive metals. The air is not particularly cold here, but it is very damp, and the howling weather outside seems to weigh on everyone's spirits.

description.text: Due to the somewhat dim light of the star Algorel, and the cloudiness of the atmosphere, this is not a good world for farming, and the population remains quite small.

spaceport.text: Some of the locals discuss their Remembrance Day plans in the cafeteria. One of them asks you how other planets celebrate the day.

description.text: This station is so run-down that most of the workers carry oxygen masks in case a meteoroid punctures the hull, and a few of them are even dressed in full space suits. The deuterium refinery here is barely operating, the number of workers is minimal, and nearly half of them seem to be busy just welding patches onto the hull to hold the station together. At the moment, there are no repair or refueling services available here.
The level of intrigue and dalliance between the bored gentry could easily compete with the most lurid and unrealistic of Victorian fiction.

spaceport.text: The spaceport here is a shopping mall. You landed on a plain concrete slab near the "cargo entrance," where raw goods are bought and sold. But the other end of the building holds hangars for luxury ships and glass-windowed storefronts where mannequins are dressed in outlandish and horribly impractical outfits. There is a sparse cafeteria for dock workers near your entrance, and fancy steakhouses and seafood places for the more wealthy visitors.

description.text: Triton Station serves both as a refinery for hyperspace fuel, and as a garrison for ships of the Republic Navy. Patrol ships are constantly landing here and then taking off to scour the surrounding systems for pirates. Since pirates are scarce in this part of space, it seems like a very tedious job.

spaceport.text: The mess hall is empty except for one table where some Navy officers are playing a card game. They are sitting right under a ventilation duct, and the cards keep blowing off the table; the station's low simulated gravity is not enough to hold them there.

description.text: Centuries ago Mainsail was home to pirates of the old-fashioned variety, fleets of motor boats or even old-fashioned sailing vessels that would launch raids against the city-ships.

spaceport.text: Few goods are produced here; most of the people rich enough to live on Mainsail are connected with interplanetary corporations whose physical business takes place elsewhere.

description.text: While these diamonds are unfortunately not economical to collect with current human technology, if you were so inclined you could perhaps make an attempt at catching one as it fell, deep within the atmosphere where they are largest.
In the lowlands, large farms support sprawling cities full of factories, a striking contrast to the simplicity and isolation of the mountain villages.

spaceport.text: Befitting their isolationist stance, the port has not been dolled up for Remembrance Day, though you are able to make out a celebration taking place in the city below.

description.text: When the first colonists landed, they thought that they had found a dream world on Thunder: perfect gravity, perfect temperature, perfect atmosphere. Unfortunately, they soon discovered that the planet has unusually high tectonic activity, enough that building anything higher than two stories is almost impossible. Because of the earthquakes, attracting settlers has always been difficult for Thunder, and right now the population is only a few million.

spaceport.text: The spaceport's landing pads are all solid slabs of metal; poured concrete would be far too prone to cracking. The spaceport village itself is a sprawling collection of squat, sturdy buildings, and a sign near the entrance to the cargo warehouse reads, "Do not stack crates."

description.text: In 2655, Rowark was flushed out of his Roost by a combined Rim and Deep fleet in a battle that continues to be studied by every aspirant Navy officer in their tutelage. As you fly over the moon you spy the wrecks of countless ships dotting its surface, but what is most striking is the truly impressive battleship-sized crater that marks the spot where Rowark met his end, doggedly choosing to fight to the very last.

One island archipelago is home to the spaceport, the only part of the planet where it is safe to land uninvited. The other islands - even some that seem from a distance to be uninhabited - are often used as staging bases for pirate fleets, who guard their secrets closely.

spaceport.text: Your ship is on a landing pad only a few meters above the pounding surf, and you can't help worrying about what might happen if the tide rises any higher. If nothing else, the salt water is bound to corrode your hull if you stay here too long. You make your way to a bar where a cage hanging from the ceiling holds an actual parrot. After trying for a while to get it to talk to you, you realize that it is dead, stuffed and nailed to its perch.

description.text: The environment here, orbiting so close to a red dwarf star, is very different from most other settled planets. The scientists estimate this star system to be over ten billion years old, enough that life here has had much more time to develop and evolve than on any planet orbiting a brighter, more short-lived star.

spaceport.text: Within the building is a sun-lit atrium, with separate storefronts for the commodity exchange, the job center, and the bank. The only place you can see where you might be able to get something to eat is a bar, advertised by a sign showing an Erlenmeyer flask with a folding paper umbrella hung over the rim.

description.text: The gravity is far less than ideal for human development, but the atmosphere is breathable and some tourists come to the planet just for the experience of being able to run and jump in low gravity without the need for a suit or oxygen tanks.
